claimType: post-hoc mechanism audit on already-rendered U5a outputs; not confirmatory efficacy evidence
motivation: U5a preserved identical primitive counts but calibrated covariance lost to depth-only covariance in all five exposed rooms. Calibrated covariance often increased held-out-view coverage while substantially increasing FARO depth error. Because the CPU reference rasterizer reports the first contributing Gaussian center depth, enlarging uncertain Gaussian footprints may introduce foreground occlusion leakage. U5c tests this mechanism without rerendering or changing any representation parameter.

inputs.renderedDepth: reuse the exact 120 immutable U5a float32 depth files whose SHA256 values are recorded in the frozen U5a result
inputs.faroDepth: reuse the exact 40 held-out FARO float32 target depths and SHA256 values recorded in U5a targets.json

pairwiseConvention.challengerOnly: challenger finite and reference non-finite on a FARO-valid pixel
pairwiseConvention.referenceOnly: reference finite and challenger non-finite on a FARO-valid pixel
pairwiseConvention.bothFinite: both renders finite on a FARO-valid pixel
pairwiseConvention.correctToWrong: both finite, reference within 0.05m and challenger outside 0.05m
pairwiseConvention.wrongToCorrect: both finite, challenger within 0.05m and reference outside 0.05m

perTargetMetrics: challenger-only coverage fraction of FARO-valid pixels
reference-only coverage fraction of FARO-valid pixels
challenger-only within-5cm fraction of FARO-valid pixels
challenger-only foreground-wrong fraction of FARO-valid pixels
challenger-only background-wrong fraction of FARO-valid pixels
among challenger-only pixels: foreground-wrong share, background-wrong share, within-5cm share
among both-finite pixels: challenger-closer fraction and reference-closer fraction
reference-correct challenger-wrong fraction of FARO-valid pixels
challenger-correct reference-wrong fraction of FARO-valid pixels
median challenger-minus-reference rendered depth on both-finite pixels
median challenger-minus-reference absolute FARO error on both-finite pixels

sceneAggregation.fractionRule: arithmetic mean across the same eight frozen target views
sceneAggregation.medianShiftRule: arithmetic mean across defined per-target medians; undefined only if no target view has a defined median
sceneAggregation.pooledCounts: raw pixel counts are summed across the eight target views and reported separately

crossSceneDescriptive.primaryMechanismReadout: median across scenes of candidate-vs-depth-only challenger-only foreground-wrong share among challenger-only pixels
secondary: median both-finite candidate-minus-depth-only absolute error shift
crossSceneDescriptive.percentileConvention: nearest-rank on sorted bootstrap values with exact half-index ties resolved to the lower index, matching U3c/U5a

interpretation.supportsOcclusionLeakageMechanism: calibrated covariance gains coverage mainly through candidate-only pixels that are foreground-wrong, and/or converts many depth-only-correct shared pixels into candidate-wrong pixels; shuffled behavior helps determine whether association placement matters
interpretation.coverageButNotForegroundLeakage: coverage gains are primarily background-wrong or mixed; do not claim foreground occlusion as the dominant mechanism
interpretation.sharedPixelErrorDominates: if most degradation occurs where both methods already render, the failure is not merely added coverage but changed frontmost-splat selection on existing support
interpretation.noEffect: pairwise maps are nearly identical; U5a degradation then comes from a small number of high-impact views rather than a broad occlusion mechanism

claimBoundary: U5c may explain U5a failure but cannot rescue the frozen U5a rule or establish efficacy. No U5b is opened from U5c alone. Any future representation rule must be frozen as a new exploratory study before producing new outcomes.
